customers_say: Customers find the smart lock to be a premium product with solid build quality, great looks, and smooth installation process. They appreciate its security features and multiple access options, with one customer highlighting the fingerprint and passcode entry options for versatility. The functionality receives mixed reviews - while many say it works well, some report issues with the front lock not working and the fingerprint scanner stopping unexpectedly. Additionally, connectivity is a concern, with several customers reporting no WiFi connectivity.
